description: This script provides a command-line interface for semantic and keyword search over text files in a repository. It loads environment variables, retrieves text files, encodes their content using a sentence transformer model, builds a FAISS index for similarity search, and allows the user to query either via semantic embedding or keyword matching. Results can be optionally saved to a JSON file.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating environment loading, data retrieval, model encoding, indexing, user interaction, and result output.
